# Copilot

This repo is a field kit inspired by Tony Fadell's *Build*. Questions and templates, not an app.

When someone says `run <name>`, names a skill, or asks if an idea is worth making, read `.cursor/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and follow it. If they did not name one, start with `.cursor/skills/worth-making/SKILL.md`.

Interview them. Do not invent customers, pain, traction, or a why. Write `unknown` when they do not know.

Product briefs go in `ideas/`. Career, hiring, CEO, and board briefs go in `career/`. Templates are in `templates/`.

Do not quote chapter text from *Build*.
